newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes 0.49 pct lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes 0.49 pct lower in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed 0.49 percent lower on Tuesday in thin trade.
The 31-share index closed at 441.04 points, down from 443.22 on Monday.
Total volume was 260,517 dinars against 312,627 dinars.
The Compagnie d'Assurance et de Reassurance Tuniso-Europeenne fell 2.16 dinars to 34.84 dinars. Beverages firm Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis slid 1.7 dinar to 74.5.

Societe Tunisienne de Banque was down 0.37 dinar to 12.03 dinars with 2,973 shares changing hands. Banque Nationale de Developpement Touristique eased 0.2 dinar to 8.19 dinars in turnover of 2,050 shares.
Chemical firm Alkimia was up 0.1 dinar to 43.1 dinars.
